Lena (CS): Heads-up — during NebulaHealth onboarding today they called out two recurring pain points: (1) per-route cost attribution is confusing for their finance team, (2) streaming disconnects when long system prompts + attachments are used. They asked if we can prioritize fixes before renewal conversation next month.
Tom (AE): Thanks for flagging. Renewal is up in 5 weeks, account shows high product usage but churn risk if billing surprises persist. They explicitly said 'we can't explain spikes to our CFO'.
Omar (PM): @Lena can you paste any exact lines they gave about cost attribution? We'll slot into next week's triage. My proposal: label cost attribution as P1 (billing visibility), streaming disconnects as P2 (stability) unless we see crashes.
Lena (CS): Quote from customer: "We get a 3x jump some days and have no per-route break down — makes forecasting impossible." Also they hit streaming drop ~3x in last week with long system prompt + PDF.
Priya (Eng): FYI the streaming drops likely come from our current chunking + reauth retry logic. Quick workaround: increase keepalive and lower chunk size on the route. Example flag we can flip temporarily: `stream.chunk_size=64kb` and `stream.keepalive=90s`. That should reduce reconnects while we investigate root cause.
insights-bot: Created ticket CS-4821 (nebula-health-cost-attrib) and CS-4822 (nebula-health-stream-reconnect). Linked: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-4821
Omar (PM): I'll own CS-4821. Priya, can you validate the workaround and send a short runbook we can share to the customer? If it works, we can do a temporary config change on their Dedicated pool.
Priya (Eng): Yep — will test today and post runbook here (small steps + revert).
Tom (AE): I'll set up a 30m sync with their finance lead next Tue and include the runbook. Also will confirm renewal timeline and capture any other asks. :thumbsup:
Lena (CS): Great — thanks team. I'll forward the customer's sample logs to CS-4822 now and add more context in the ticket.
